snippet.title: BlackGate VR | Alien Gameplay Trailer (Meta Quest)
snippet.description:
Avail Oct 2nd. Pre-order now and receive the exclusive Founder's Pack:
https://www.funtrainvr.com/bglanding

Become the predator. Evolve in the dark.

In this new trailer for BlackGate, experience the game from the alien’s point of view — not as the hunted, but as the hunter.

This is not a survival story.
It’s an extinction event.

Drifting for eons. Awakened by human curiosity. You are the spawn that the Black Knight Satellite has released upon the station. Stalk the crew. Feed on their fear. Adapt to their resistance. Evolve into the perfect predator.

BlackGate is a 4v1 zero-gravity sci-fi horror game coming soon to Meta Quest.
